ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is the “Forecast Map of Cold Dew Wind in the Southern Late Rice Region from September 19–22, 2011”; the late rice region and the area affected by cold dew wind mainly appear in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River, the lowlands of South China, and the southeastern coastal area; the Yunnan-Guizhou region near Kunming and Guiyang is not within the main late rice distribution range. Then reason: the growth of late rice requires a relatively long high-temperature growing period and sufficient heat. The Yunnan-Guizhou region is located on the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, with relatively high terrain elevation; temperature decreases as elevation rises, and heat conditions are insufficient, so it is generally not suitable for the distribution of late rice.
